vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "Don't bother picking around the tents. Walk out. The land feeds people who go looking."
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
🛡️ Gianna, Eamon, Malavika and Lamia met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Gianna, Eamon, Malavika, Lamia are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Gianna, Lamia and Petra met them at the door — 3 put down. Gianna, Lamia, Petra are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Victor just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Malavika just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lamia just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Gianna, Malavika, Lamia and Omar met them at the door — 4 put down. Gianna, Lamia, Omar are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Malavika just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lamia just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Petra just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Gianna, Lamia and Petra met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Lamia, Petra are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
Lamia strikes the Scarred Ugly-Eyes.
Gianna strikes the Scarred Ugly-Eyes.
The Scarred Ugly-Eyes falls.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Gianna just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
